findings.one_line: Under the displayed pairing, both P^lb_omega and pi^lb_omega change with omega: pi^lb_omega always selects exactly the m/2 S^(1) treatment arms, so its policy-mixture survival (and log quantile) is invariant in omega; neighboring signs do not change a component of that paired mixture. Rebuild the confidence converse using a policy held fixed across neighboring laws (and derive its separation), or change the stated handle.
